note: Triage ONLY decides review order and pseudo-label eligibility. It never marks anything verified. Ramps map a raw signal linearly from 'bad' (0) to 'good' (1). Defaults set from the 1,296-candidate distribution on 2026-10-04 (docs/gold_review.md); PROVISIONAL until calibrated against human decisions.

threshold_notes.high_confidence: applied to the final confidence (after artifact penalties); ~median of the 2026-10-04 distribution
threshold_notes.review: applied to the base confidence (BEFORE artifact penalties): text artifacts are correctable, so they send a segment to review, never to rejection
threshold_notes.never_reject_flags: an unread translator note lowers alignment and agreement too, but the audio is usable after a reviewer deletes the note
